texts.li: {X_nameDef} of the Empire gently corrected the way {A_nameDef} bowed, then showed {A_objective} the right one, and the one for a knight, and the one you never use.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} what all the Empire's titles mean. {X_nameDef} began with yeoman and had reached baron by the end of supper.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that at court, a guest who finishes everything on the plate is saying the host was mean with the portions. {A_nameDef} finished everything anyway.
[x:royal] {X_nameDef} let {A_nameDef} address {X_objective} without the title, just this once, and seemed to enjoy it more than {X_pronoun} let on.
[lowtech] {X_nameDef} looked around the colony's hall and said, kindly, that the Empire's halls were much the same once, a very long time ago.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} the news from court: a count has been made a duke, a duke has been sent to a moon, and nobody is saying why.
According to {X_nameDef}, the high stellarch has a new favorite, and half the Empire is pretending not to notice. {A_nameDef} wanted every detail.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a feast at court that lasted nine days, and about the man who tried to stay awake for all of it.
[x:royal] {X_nameDef}, who holds a title of {X_possessive} own, told {A_nameDef} which courtiers to trust, which to flatter, and which to avoid in corridors.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} explained to {A_nameDef} how the senate votes: by tribe, then by century, then by whoever is still awake. {A_nameDef} said the council was simpler. {X_nameDef} looked doubtful.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that in {FACTION} every citizen can speak in the forum, and most of them do, at once.
{A_nameDef} asked {X_nameDef} who really runs {FACTION}. {X_nameDef} laughed and said the grain merchants, but not to tell the senators.
[colony:Open] {X_nameDef} said the colony's council reminded {X_objective} of the republic's early days, before the old families bought it.
{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} looked at the colony's walls for a long time, then showed {A_nameDef} how the republic's builders set an arch so it holds itself up.
{X_nameDef} drew a column in the dust for {A_nameDef}: base, shaft and capital, and the little swell in the middle that makes it look straight.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} argued about mortar until dark. {X_nameDef}'s people put ash from a volcano in theirs; {A_nameDef} is now looking for a volcano.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a cattle drive across the salt flats, two hundred head and one canteen. The canteen grew more heroic every time {X_pronoun} told it.
{X_nameDef} swore to {A_nameDef} that back home there's a mule that can count to five and only works for the mayor.
{X_nameDef} let {A_nameDef} taste the chemshine {FACTION} brews. {A_nameDef} is still coughing, and still talking about it.
[night] By the fire, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about the bandit who robbed the same stagecoach eleven times and was finally hired to guard it.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {FACTION}'s ranchers throw a loop over a running steer. {A_nameDef} caught a fence post, then a chicken, then, late in the afternoon, a goat.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} the knot ranchers use for a halter that won't tighten on the animal. {A_nameDef} has retied every halter in the colony since.
{A_nameDef} watched {X_nameDef} talk a nervous horse into standing still with nothing but a low voice and a lot of patience, and asked how. {X_nameDef} said it was mostly the patience.
